text:
### 5. Specific Responsibilities  
**Risk Appetite Statement:**
- Review annually
- Align with strategic objectives
- Define tolerances (capital, losses, regulatory)
- Communicate to business units  
**Capital Planning:**
- Annual capital plan review
- Stress testing scenarios (recession, market shock, fraud)
- Capital ratio monitoring (quarterly)
- Dividend/distribution approval (if applicable)  
**Audit Oversight:**
- Review Internal Audit plan (annual)
- Monitor audit findings and remediation
- Assess Internal Audit independence
- Approve Internal Audit budget  
**Regulatory Engagement:**
- Receive FCA/PRA feedback
- Approve regulatory responses
- Discuss regulatory concerns/orders
- Plan remediation for findings  
**Board Education:**
- Annual risk management training
- Market risk overview (quarterly)
- Emerging risk briefings
- Regulatory change updates

raw_entities.name: Risk Appetite Statement
raw_entities.description: A formal statement defining the bank's tolerance for capital, losses, and regulatory risk exposure. The statement is reviewed annually and aligned with strategic objectives, then communicated to all business units to ensure consistent risk management across the organisation.

raw_entities.name: Capital Risk
raw_entities.description: Capital adequacy and distribution risk managed through annual capital planning, stress testing, and quarterly capital ratio monitoring. The bank assesses capital resilience under recession and market shock scenarios.
context: Stress testing scenarios (recession, market shock, fraud)

raw_entities.name: Fraud Risk
raw_entities.description: Fraud risk is incorporated into the bank's stress testing scenarios as part of capital planning and resilience assessment.
context: Stress testing scenarios (recession, market shock, fraud)

raw_entities.name: Market Risk
raw_entities.description: Market risk is subject to quarterly board oversight through market risk overview briefings to ensure awareness of market conditions and exposures.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Risk
raw_entities.description: Regulatory risk encompasses FCA/PRA feedback, regulatory orders, and compliance concerns. The board approves regulatory responses and plans remediation for regulatory findings.

raw_entities.name: Emerging Risk
raw_entities.description: Emerging risks are monitored and communicated to the board through periodic briefings to ensure awareness of new and evolving risk exposures.

raw_entities.name: Annual Risk Appetite Statement Review
raw_entities.description: The board is responsible for reviewing the Risk Appetite Statement annually to ensure it remains aligned with strategic objectives and reflects current risk tolerances.

raw_entities.name: Annual Capital Plan Review
raw_entities.description: The board conducts an annual review of the capital plan, including stress testing under recession, market shock, and fraud scenarios.
context: Stress testing scenarios (recession, market shock, fraud)

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Capital Ratio Monitoring
raw_entities.description: The board monitors capital ratios on a quarterly basis to ensure the bank maintains adequate capital levels.

raw_entities.name: Annual Internal Audit Plan Review
raw_entities.description: The board reviews the Internal Audit plan annually and approves the Internal Audit budget as part of audit oversight responsibilities.

raw_entities.name: Internal Audit Findings and Remediation Monitoring
raw_entities.description: The board monitors audit findings and tracks remediation progress to ensure timely resolution of identified control weaknesses.

raw_entities.name: Internal Audit Independence Assessment
raw_entities.description: The board assesses the independence of the Internal Audit function to ensure it can operate without undue influence or constraint.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Response Approval
raw_entities.description: The board approves the bank's responses to FCA/PRA feedback and regulatory orders.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Remediation Planning
raw_entities.description: The board plans and oversees remediation activities for regulatory findings and concerns.

raw_entities.name: Annual Risk Management Training
raw_entities.description: The board receives annual risk management training to maintain competency in risk governance and oversight.

raw_entities.name: Quarterly Market Risk Overview
raw_entities.description: The board receives quarterly briefings on market risk conditions and exposures.

raw_entities.name: Emerging Risk Briefings
raw_entities.description: The board receives periodic briefings on emerging risks to maintain awareness of new and evolving risk exposures.

raw_entities.name: Regulatory Change Updates
raw_entities.description: The board receives updates on regulatory changes to ensure awareness of new compliance obligations and requirements.

raw_entities.name: Risk Appetite Communication to Business Units
raw_entities.description: The board ensures the Risk Appetite Statement is communicated to all business units to align risk management practices across the organisation.

raw_entities.name: Dividend and Distribution Approval
raw_entities.description: The board approves dividend and distribution decisions as part of capital planning oversight.
